description: Tools of the v4 L-section assistant. The agent-conversation dataset (scripts/agent_conversations_v4.py) is generated against exactly these signatures; the Phase 1 implementations must follow them. Lines: the 3rd and 4th lines share chainages and bridge numbers, so every query names the line ('3rd line' or '4th line').

function.name: read_sheet
function.description: Read an uploaded file (a PDF with one or more pages, or an image of one sheet) into the store. Returns per page: page type (L-section sheet, cover/index, GAD, other), sheet id, line, chainage range, revision, how it was read (PDF text layer = exact, or image + model), image DPI, layout verdict (known / similar / unknown, with notes), counts of what was read, drawing findings, and whether the page was already stored (same file), stored as a new version, or new. Also returns the continuity check between consecutive sheets.

function.name: query
function.description: Look up what was read from the sheets (the store). kind: 'bridge' (one bridge: callout, level block, sheet), 'bridges_in_range' (bridges between two chainages, with levels), 'sheet_for_chainage' (which sheet covers a chainage), 'curve' (one curve box), 'notes' (a sheet's general notes; optional term to find the note about something), 'abbreviation' (meaning of a term from the sheets' abbreviation tables), 'tbm' (one bench mark), 'versions' (every stored version of a sheet: revision, file, date; the latest is used by default), 'bridges_on_sheet' (all bridges of one sheet with levels, for schedules and reports), 'gradient' (the proposed gradient at a chainage, between its two grade points), 'grade_points' (grade points with FL and gradients before/after, between two chainages or on a sheet), 'transition' (whether a chainage is on a straight, transition or circular curve, with the ST/TC/CT/TS points either side), 'km_post' (the km posts either side of a chainage, with the existing-line km), 'stations' (stations named on the sheets of a line), 'sheet_info' (drawing number, sheet number, chainage range, scale, date, revision, previous/next sheet, reference drawings), 'text' (search every word printed on the sheets for a word or phrase: where it is printed).

function.name: band_at
function.description: Data-band values at one or more chainages: each value is interpolated between the two printed columns either side, y = y1 + (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) * (x - x1); on a printed column y is that column. Returns x1, x2, both columns and y for every row.

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact arithmetic on numbers (+ - * / and parentheses). Use it for every calculation.

function.name: look
function.description: Zoom into an area of a sheet image and ask the vision model about it (for anything not already in the store).

function.name: search_library
function.description: Search the local reference library (codes, manuals, standards, abbreviation lists supplied by the team).

function.name: web_search
function.description: Internet lookup of the general meaning of one term. Pass only the bare term (never sentences, chainages, levels, bridge or sheet numbers, names); code builds the query and blocks anything identifying.
